# Ysolde Fennford

Ysolde Fennford is currently a Nutrient Solution Engineer at Nexvane Networks, a leading innovator in vertical farming technologies headquartered in Cyrellis City. Since joining Nexvane in early 2021, Ysolde has been instrumental in advancing PhytaTrack, the company’s flagship system that integrates environmental sensors with AI-driven analytics to dynamically optimize nutrient dosing schedules for hydroponic crops.

Ysolde’s career in indoor agriculture began over a decade ago, following her graduation in Agricultural Chemistry. From 2012 to 2017, she worked at AgriSynth Labs, a boutique R&D firm specializing in plant nutrient formulations. During this period, she developed and patented an ion-exchange dosing system, codename “IonWeave,” which significantly enhanced nutrient uptake efficiency by fine-tuning ion balance tailored to specific crop species. IonWeave remains a foundational technology in modern nutrient delivery systems used across the industry.

In 2017, Ysolde transitioned to Biostratec Innovations, where she led a team focused on nutrient solution automation and precision feeding regimens for leafy greens and microgreens. Her project “NutrifyPulse” introduced adaptive nutrient cycling protocols that reduced fertilizer waste by 18% while maintaining yield quality. This work deepened her expertise in integrating sensor feedback loops with complex dosing algorithms.

At Nexvane Networks, Ysolde’s focus is on the convergence of sensor data streams—such as pH, electrical conductivity, ambient humidity, and temperature—with AI models that forecast crop nutrient requirements. PhytaTrack’s real-time nutrient scheduling not only boosts yield consistency but also minimizes environmental impact, aligning with Nexvane’s sustainability goals.

Ysolde is known for methodical experimentation combined with a collaborative approach. She frequently coordinates with software engineers, agronomists, and data scientists to prototype and validate new formulations and dosing strategies. Her design philosophy emphasizes modular, scalable solutions that can be adapted for a variety of crops and controlled environment agriculture setups.

Her notable contributions to Nexvane include leading the “NexusBloom” initiative, which optimized nutrient profiles for flowering crops in multi-level grow towers, resulting in a 12% increase in bloom uniformity metrics across pilot farms. She also champions knowledge-sharing forums within the company, mentoring junior engineers and contributing to quarterly technical briefings.

Within the vertical farming ecosystem, Ysolde works closely with product managers, hardware teams responsible for sensor integration, and field specialists who oversee pilot site deployments. Her multidisciplinary expertise and hands-on leadership continue to drive innovation at the intersection of plant nutrition science and AI-enabled precision agriculture technologies.
